gaps.sentence: The expedition will go ahead ___ the sponsors confirm the funding.
gaps.explanation: 'Provided that' = only if, a formal positive condition.

gaps.sentence: He lowered his voice ___ wake the baby.
gaps.explanation: Negative purpose = so as not to / in order not to + infinitive.

gaps.sentence: ___ both parties agree, the contract can be terminated early.
gaps.explanation: 'Provided (that)' introduces the formal condition for early termination.

gaps.sentence: ___ being remarkably fast, the new chip consumes far less power.
gaps.explanation: 'Besides + -ing' adds a further advantage; 'despite of' does not exist.

gaps.sentence: ___ the strike, trains will run a reduced service all week.
gaps.explanation: 'Because of the strike' gives the reason for the reduced service.

gaps.sentence: The scheme creates hundreds of jobs. ___, it attracts tourism to the region.
gaps.explanation: 'In addition' introduces another benefit of the scheme.

gaps.sentence: The drug is remarkably effective. ___, it has almost no side effects.
gaps.explanation: 'Furthermore' introduces an additional point supporting the same claim.

gaps.sentence: I'll take the job ___ they don't offer me any more money.
gaps.explanation: 'Even if' concedes a future possibility that will not change the decision.
